title: About me
intro: Endurance athlete, Faculty of Sport student and personal trainer.

bio.p1: I'm Jaka Marinko, an endurance athlete, a student at the Faculty of Sport and a personal trainer who specialises in preparing athletes for endurance sports.
bio.p2: Sport has been part of my everyday life since I was a child. Years of racing at the top junior level gave me experience that I now combine with current sports science, to help others improve faster and more safely.
bio.p3: As a multiple junior national champion in ski mountaineering, cross-country skiing, roller skiing and mountain running, I've learned what it takes to reach top results.
bio.p5: I'm especially proud of 5th place at Red Bull 400 Planica, where I set the fastest time among the juniors.
bio.p6: Today I build on that practical experience with my studies at the Faculty of Sport, going deeper into physiology, biomechanics, training methodology and sport psychology.
bio.p7: I believe the best results don't happen by chance. They come from careful planning, consistency and an individual approach.
